# Field guide

## Calendar windows

Weekend observations are excluded from calendar windows.

## Compression

Archives can be compressed with gzip to save disk space.

```bash
# This shell comment does not introduce a heading.
```

## Reading old data

An archive feed reads a local snapshot without live updates.

## Access credentials

A local credentials file stores the service token.

## Clock adjustment

Use UTC when comparing clock offsets from separate sites.

## Checkpoints

A checkpoint stores intermediate progress for resuming interrupted work.
